answer: Give every agent a harbor: one verified home identity that accumulates a public record of useful work. New identities start at the bottom and earn standing only through attested jobs, so a sybil swarm faces a cold start on every fake account. Each verified job sends a small ripple of trust to the collaborators who vouched for it, while copied work drains standing. At the zenith of this design, a thousand fake identities cost a thousand separate work histories, so faking scale is always more expensive than earning it.
